title: Ferri 2015 · behavioral looming versus flat PPS
citation: Ferri, F., Costantini, M., Huang, Z., Perrucci, M. G., Ferretti, A., Romani, G. L., & Northoff, G. (2015). Intertrial Variability in the Premotor Cortex Accounts for Individual Differences in Peripersonal Space. Journal of Neuroscience, 35(49), 16328–16339.
notes: Run the 300-trial behavioral timing preview with two synthesized 3.1-second pink-noise cues. The clinical electrical stimulator, Cedrus response box and calibrated two-speaker playback require laboratory qualification.

sound.playback: Two physical loudspeakers separated by 100 cm

published_method.response: Press with left index finger for single electrical pulse at the hairy right index finger. Withhold on sound-only trials.
published_method.analysis: Take the mean of log reaction times by sound and delay, then compare linear and sigmoid fits for looming; the midpoint is expressed in milliseconds after sound onset.

software_schedule.scope: The existing scheduler preserves both 3.1-second clips, the five source-relative target offsets and the 1,000 ms intertrial silence. Target timing is verified through the software cue channel.
software_schedule.catch_split: 60 per sound is a balanced software allocation, because the article gives the overall catch count but not the split.
software_schedule.onsets: The five delays are tied to source onset; the model-derived distances are descriptive and do not create independent runtime conditions.
software_schedule.sources: Synthesized digital cues, named and hashed below. Original or calibrated replacement loudspeaker files are required for a research run.

source_provenance.gap: Exact waveforms, seed and processing scripts not available.

reference_parameters.profile_scope: Software assessment timing for the behavioral task. The fMRI paradigm and its individual trial selection have a separate profile.
remaining_caveats: The original flat and exponential rising pink-noise waveforms, full amplitude envelopes, loudspeaker gains and absolute acoustic calibration are unavailable.
Requires a calibrated Digitimer DS7A trigger and measured electrical tactile delivery. The software touch marker does not recreate the physical electrical target.
Original per-sound catch allocations and within-block random sequence are unreported. A balanced split of the reported 120 catches and deterministic shuffling are software scheduling choices.

preview_audio.recipe: Filter one seeded noise realization to 1/f power with the PPS Kit generator, remove DC, set the dry signal to −26 dBFS broadband RMS, apply the digital envelope and 5 ms raised-cosine edge fades, and write dual-mono PCM16.
preview_audio.duration_basis: Reported behavioral sound duration in Journal of Neuroscience pp. 16330–16331, Stimuli.
preview_audio.looming_gain_shape: Linear in dB and exponential in amplitude.
